summary: "History of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, Volume 5" is a historical chronicle published in 1909. This volume covers fifteen months from May 1842 to August 1843 in the life of Joseph Smith and the early Latter Day Saint movement. Based on Smith's writings and accounts by his scribes, it forms part of a seven-volume series edited by B. H. Roberts. The work documents a pivotal period in church history through narrative accounts, correspondence, and contemporary records of Smith's activities and teachings.
